items.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
items.summary: The derivatives regulator issues a rule on data reporting for event contracts and new guidance for how crypto assets can be used to meet regulatory requirements.

items.title: New York judge declines to block Kalshi from operating in the state for now
items.summary: Judge Melissa Crane did not shut down Kalshi's operations in a hearing Monday, but did say she wanted both parties to present their full arguments in an expedited fashion.

items.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang faces Senate scrutiny despite Trump-backed return as CEO
items.summary: Congressional scrutiny will continue even as CEO returns to lead the company after his affair scandal and its national-security implications.

items.title: Bitcoin rebound already losing steam as AI trade returns with a bang
items.summary: Nvidia jumped more than 30% and has recovered most of its losses since CEO Jensen Huang stepped down, but bitcoin is lagging as U.S. selling persists, traders said.

items.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
items.summary: ProShares' rival CoinDesk 20 Crypto ETF (KRYP) holds $1.81 million in assets nearly 10 months post-launch.

items.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
items.summary: Elliptic found that nearly all the mixing transactions, known as coinjoins, were coordinated by an entity called Kruw during fixed daily hours, suggesting potential handoffs to China-based money launderers.

items.title: Eric Trump-backed American Bitcoin secures $150 million loan against its bitcoin
items.summary: The Nasdaq-listed crypto miner can borrow without selling its reserves or issuing new shares, but falling BTC prices could force it to pledge more collateral.

items.title: Bitcoin's 5-year return is nearly zero, great narratives are fading and what's left is the Fed
Nvidia soars as Jensen Huang returns to lead company
items.summary: The Nasdaq gained more than 6% as Nvidia rose as much as 35%. After a brief surge, crypto returned to a more muted advance.

items.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
items.summary: The Intercontinental Exchange-backed venture said it has confirmed 113 assets for listing as trading begins, following a wave of objections from companies initially picked for inclusion.

items.title: Google wants to make you the star of your own AI slop movies
items.summary: Viewers could find their AI-doppelgangers inserted into the crowd during the Cricket World Cup, or take a leading role in their very own romantic comedy.

items.title: Ethereum Foundation doubles protocol security team ahead of overhaul
items.summary: The foundation said its next upgrade will be harder than the Merge, and the required pace of development will make it easier to ship bugs.

items.title: CFTC staff say exchanges can count Bitcoin toward operating reserves
items.summary: The staff guidance allows Bitcoin, Ether and payment stablecoins to count towards operating reserves.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
items.summary: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

items.title: Kalshi secures temporary win in New York gambling law dispute
items.summary: The ruling allows Kalshi to continue operating as its legal battle with New York over sports-related event contracts moves toward a January hearing.

items.title: BTCS offloads $44M in ETH to reduce DeFi debt amid market downturn
items.summary: BTCS sold more than half its Ether holdings to reduce leverage following the market sell-off, while BitMine added another 7,819 ETH to its treasury.

items.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
items.summary: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

items.title: Cuomo says rivals urged companies to opt out of OKXICE tokenized stocks
items.summary: Former New York Gov. Andrew Cuomo said competitors encouraged companies to opt out of OKXICE’s rollout, while some issuers simply wanted more time.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds 17% from $55K lows as Nvidia rally sparks $500M crypto liquidations
items.summary: Bitcoin price upside hit $64,500 as risk assets surged on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s reinstatement, while crypto liquidations topped $500 million four hours.

items.title: China's Z.ai Says Its New AI Model Can Think Like One Four Times Its Size
items.summary: GLM-5.4 uses a looping architecture to squeeze more reasoning power from fewer parameters, challenging the expensive approach favored by American AI giants.

items.title: OpenAI Will Pay You Up to $8K to Preach the AI Gospel to Small Businesses
items.summary: OpenAI wants local AI evangelists to bring ChatGPT to Main Street. Its new OpenWorks program pays up to $8,000 monthly, provided you can actually help businesses get things done locally.

items.title: Why One Math Proof Has AI Experts Warning Humans Might Soon Lose Control
items.summary: Alexandr Wang says Claude’s role in a verified Riemann Hypothesis proof signals a turning point, warning that powerful self-improving AI systems could advance faster than people can supervise them.

items.title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
items.summary: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these."

items.title: Why Nvidia Needed Jensen Huang Back—And What His Return Really Changes
items.summary: Huang's 11-day absence exposed the importance of his customer ties, influence in Washington and hold on Silicon Valley. The stock is soaring, but the comeback brings risks of its own.

items.title: GPU Jesus Has Risen: Jensen Huang’s Nvidia Comeback Gets a Meme Parade
items.summary: Hollywood, WWE and GPU Jesus joined the celebration after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang on Monday, while viral AI memes cast Anthropic's Dario Amodei as the unlikely villain of the comeback.

items.title: Solo Bitcoin Miner Scores Again, Hitting $191,000 Jackpot Against the Odds
items.summary: The lone miner solved block 977057 through Solo CKPool, pocketing 3.13 BTC (worth about $191,000) in a lottery-like feat that normally only industrial-scale mining farms pull off.

items.title: Perps and Swaps: How to Trade the News on Decrypt
items.summary: Decrypt readers can now swap tokens and trade perpetual futures from a single Money Account. Here's how The Information Exchange works.

items.title: Jensen Huang’s Wealth Rises $36 Billion as Nvidia Surge Burns Short Sellers for $12 Billion
items.summary: Nvidia shares jumped more than 33% after the board reinstated Huang 11 days post-resignation, adding over $36 billion to his fortune while dealing short sellers their worst single-day loss since at least 2019.

items.title: Tom Lee Says Ethereum Is as Scarce as Bitcoin—And Bitmine Just Bought More
items.summary: Chairman Tom Lee argued ETH’s supply has grown just 0.90% annually since mid-2025—roughly matching Bitcoin’s 0.82% and far below Solana, XRP and Cardano.
